root_cause: Each RuntimeEnvironment scope (MediaQuery, app view) exposed one whole-value key; MediaQueryData readers and the scenario's size reader depended on that single key, so any field change rebuilt them.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/context.rs (per-aspect MediaQuery* wrappers installed in every RuntimeEnvironment scope; update_scope_aspects replaces only changed fields; BuildContext::media_query_size/_device_pixel_ratio/_text_scale/_platform_brightness/_padding/_view_padding/_view_insets); crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/reconciliation.rs (install on scope mount in inherited_contexts_for_consumers, update on scope value change)
harness: misc__media_query_size_aspect: match (was builder_runs 1 vs 2 at 32 ms; now 1 vs 1). Scenario twin changed to context.media_query_size() (diagnostic twin using the new API; reported).
api_change: additive: BuildContext gains Option-returning media_query_* readers. depend_on::<MediaQueryData>() unchanged. BuildContext::viewport() still ignores MediaQuery overrides. Aspect readers return None outside an environment scope.
limitations: Covers the seven MediaQuery aspects Incular stores; other RuntimeEnvironment fields (locales, accessibility flags, display features) still use the whole-value key. Aspect readers do not fall back to the window value outside a scope.
note: Confirmed before fixing: scenario diverged at 32 ms.

root_cause: Incular already has a public custom update predicate: InheritedModelData::update_should_notify, read with InheritedModel::inherit_from(context, None) for dependents that read no aspect. That matches Flutter's InheritedWidget updateShouldNotify plus dependOnInheritedWidgetOfExactType.
limitations: There is no separate InheritedWidget type; the aspect-less reader is the InheritedWidget equivalent and the model type is named InheritedModel. Naming gap only.
note: Read inherited_data.rs:173-253 and the test: update_should_notify=false suppresses the aspect-less reader; equal models notify nobody.

root_cause: Keyed reuse looks only at the old children of the parent being reconciled (take_keyed_move over a per-transaction index built from old_children). A keyed element under another parent is never found, so it is unmounted and remounted.
harness: none (needs a stateful probe; no scenario written)
limitations: Design sketch: (1) tree-wide GlobalKey registry (key to element id) updated on mount and unmount; (2) during keyed reuse, if the registry hit is under another parent, detach it from the old parent children list and the render parent link, and attach it to the new parent; (3) the old parent's unmount sweep must skip elements already claimed in this transaction, which requires a claim set across parents and ordering rules when the old parent reconciles after the new one; (4) rebind_inherited_subtree and the render tree/layers must follow the move; (5) focus, semantics and tracked dependencies must survive. Remaining work is multi-parent transaction ordering, which is not small.
note: Assessment only, per brief. Architecture rule 8 allows divergence from Flutter here.

root_cause: Restorable<T> already accepts any Serialize + DeserializeOwned type, but this was undocumented and untested for enums and non-i64 numbers, so callers assumed hand conversion was needed.
change: crates/incular-runtime/src/restoration.rs (Restorable doc: which types restore and that DateTime/Listenable are absent); no new wrapper types.
limitations: No RestorableDateTime: the workspace has no time type in specs/architecture.json, so it is deferred. No RestorableListenable/ChangeNotifier: Incular's Listenable trait (explicit_animations.rs) has no serialization contract; Restorable::signal covers observation. Both deferred.
note: Partial by design: the enum/number part is confirmed already covered; the time and listenable parts are deferred with reasons.
